definitions.explanation: A mathematical operation that calculates the area under a curve or the accumulation of quantities; the reverse of differentiation.

examples.japanese: この{関数|かんすう}を{積分|せきぶん}する。
{積分|せきぶん}で{面積|めんせき}を{求|もと}める。
examples.english: To calculate the area using integration.

examples.japanese: {不定|ふてい}{積分|せきぶん}と{定|てい}{積分|せきぶん}がある。
examples.english: There are indefinite and definite integrals.

notes:
{積分|せきぶん} is the mathematical operation of integration — calculating accumulated quantities or areas under curves. It is the inverse of {微分|びぶん} (differentiation). Used primarily in mathematics, physics, and engineering contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {積分|せきぶん}する: to integrate
- {微分|びぶん}{積分|せきぶん}: differential and integral calculus
- {定|てい}{積分|せきぶん}: definite integral
- {不定|ふてい}{積分|せきぶん}: indefinite integral
- {積分|せきぶん}{記号|きごう}: integral sign (∫)

RELATED TERMS:
- {微分|びぶん}: differentiation (the inverse operation)
- {面積|めんせき}: area
- {原始|げんし}{関数|かんすう}: antiderivative
- {数学|すうがく}: mathematics

Used in {高校|こうこう} (high school) and university-level math. As a する verb, {積分|せきぶん}する means "to integrate (a function)."
